step1_pattern.operation: 净利润（含少数股东）÷ 平均总资产
notes: GT 定义为 "Average Total Assets"，但 2023 年实际用了期末总资产

changes_vs_seed: 题干：只替换时间表达，其余与原题一字不差
GT：沿用原 GT 的结构和写法，数字换成目标期间核实过的值；原 GT 中的错误按正确口径写
step5_question.question_previous_version: Based on Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what is P&G's return on assets (ROA) for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare to fiscal 2025? Report percentages rounded to one decimal place.
step5_question.gt_template:
ROA is Net Earnings divided by Average Total Assets.
For 2026:
Average Total Assets = ($[[Assets@FY2025]] million (2025) + $[[Assets@FY2026]] million (2026)) / 2 = $[[(Assets@FY2025 + Assets@FY2026) / 2|,.1f]] million
ROA = $[[NetEarn@FY2026]] million / $[[(Assets@FY2025 + Assets@FY2026) / 2|,.1f]] million = [[ROA@FY2026|.1f]]%
For 2025:
Average Total Assets = ($[[Assets@FY2024]] million (2024) + $[[Assets@FY2025]] million (2025)) / 2 = $[[(Assets@FY2024 + Assets@FY2025) / 2|,.1f]] million
ROA = $[[NetEarn@FY2025]] million / $[[(Assets@FY2024 + Assets@FY2025) / 2|,.1f]] million = [[ROA@FY2025|.1f]]%
ROA [[!ROA_change]] slightly from [[ROA@FY2025|.1f]]% in 2025 to [[ROA@FY2026|.1f]]% in 2026.

step2_verdict: SEED_ERROR（口径不一致）。GT 写明 ROA = 净利润 ÷ 平均总资产，FY2024 按此计算（12.3，复现）；FY2023 实际用了期末总资产：14,738 ÷ 120,829 = 12.20（与 GT 12.2 一致），按平均总资产应为 14,738 ÷ ((117,208 + 120,829)/2) = 12.4。

notes: 回测标记源于原题口径不一致，不是 pipeline 错误；新题两年统一用 GT 自己写明的平均总资产口径
